title: Barndominium near Nashville!
description:
Welcome to our unique barndominium. Treat yourself to a peaceful stay in the small quaint town of Pleasant View. Hosts Jaime and Nadia look forward to providing a hospitable experience for all guests. This property is close to shops, walking trails and parks. Everything you need is just a few minutes away in this city with a small town feel.

The space
Once you enter this studio suite, you are ready for rest and relaxation. This barndominium has an upstairs sleeping area with a queen size bed as well as a Murphy bed that allows for 2 additional guests. The living room couch invites you to kick off your shoes and enjoy a good movie on the smart TV.  Also on the top floor is a spacious walk in closet with plenty of shelves for all your personal belongings as well as a small desk just in case you need to do a little work-from-home on your laptop. Once you make your way downstairs you will find a full size kitchen with a dining area and a bathroom with a tiled walk in shower. This barn looks rustic at first glance but is very modern and quite comfortable when you step inside.

Guest access
Guest has private access to the barnominium apartment. You also have access to your own laundry room

Other things to note
This barnominium is located on the same property as the hosts primary home. 
No pets allowed
